description: Erection of three storey extension to existing storage warehouse.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed three storey warehouse extension would not be detrimental to the character of the Conservation Area or the appearance of the canal and its towpath. On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension hereby permitted is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include means of enclosure; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc).

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the extension hereby permitted is commenced in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 7 - The metal storage containers shown on drawing 9313_SK_1000 Rev A, shall be permanently removed from the site prior to commencement of development

Condition : 9 - Before first use of the extensions hereby permitted, the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 9313_TP_2020 Rev B and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 10 - 9. Any fencing constructed around the site shall be permeable to flood flow.

Condition : 11 - The construction of the foundations of the extensions of the development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences.
Condition : 13 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground.

Condition : 14 - 13. The construction of the surface and foul drainage system shall be in carried out in accordance with details submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences.

Condition : 16 - Notwithstanding the detail contained on Drawing 9313_TP_2040 Rev B, the north eastern elevation shall not be externally illuminated by any means, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - Informative 

The applicant is advised to contact British Waterways in order to ensure that any necessary consents are obtained and the works are compliant with the current British Waterways 'Code of Practice for Works affecting British Waterways'

This permission does not grant consent for any signage that may be detailed on the approved plans. The applicant will need to apply to the Local Planning Authority for advert consent prior to the erection of any signage.
